name: Hook & Roll
description:
About This Game

Hop on your Monowheel and enter the legendary Roller Tournament!

Hook & Roll is a third-person 3D platforming driving game where speed, precision, and mastery of movement are key. Control your Monowheel across challenging environments and use your multifunction hook to chain together advanced maneuvers.

Grapple, swing, boost, and redirect your momentum on the fly as you navigate complex levels built to test both your reflexes and creativity.

Key Features:

  • Fast-paced movement system – Master monowheel driving combined with grappling, swinging, and boosting

  • Skill-based level design – Tackle a variety of challenges across tracks, arenas, and hook-focused playgrounds

  • Time-based competition – Optimize your routes and improve your performance to climb the leaderboards

  • Multiple playstyles – Find the fastest path or experiment with creative movement techniques

Prove your skills across diverse scenarios, discover the most efficient routes, and push your limits to become the ultimate Roller Master.
short_desc: Roll, swing, and boost your way through this fast-paced third-person platforming driving game. Hop on your Monowheel, master your hook, find the perfect line, and beat the clock to rise through the ranks of the Roller Tournament.
